note: Frozen contract between the extractor lane (G1) and the analysis/viewer lane (G2). Neither lane may change it; both must emit/consume exactly this.

files.HAWKING_SEMANTIC_GRAPH.jsonl: one JSON object per line; each line is a node or an edge, discriminated by the `kind` field ('node'|'edge')
files.HAWKING_SEMANTIC_GRAPH.gexf: Gephi-compatible GEXF 1.3 of the file-level projection with all node attributes
files.HAWKING_SEMANTIC_GRAPH.dot: Graphviz DOT of the crate/package-level projection, deterministic node ordering
files.HAWKING_BEHAVIOUR_TO_CODE_MAP.json: behaviour contract id -> reachable code set

attrs.loc: int physical lines owned by this node
attrs.betweenness: float, filled by G2, 0.0 from extractor
attrs.runtime_hot: bool|null - true if seen in a runtime trace or bench hot path
attrs.change_freq_90d: int commits touching this file in the last 90 days
attrs.change_freq_all: int commits touching this file ever
attrs.security_sensitive: bool - touches permission, capability, credential, path allowlist, hash verification

attrs.confidence: float 0..1 - 1.0 for cargo/ast, lower for regex/heuristic

id_rules.crate: crate:<cargo package name>  OR  pkg:<python top-level package path>  OR  pkg:<npm name>

determinism.ordering: JSONL must be sorted by (kind desc so all nodes precede all edges, then type, then id). DOT and GEXF must emit nodes in sorted id order.
determinism.no_timestamps: no wall-clock timestamps inside the graph files; the commit sha is the version
determinism.reproducible: running the extractor twice on the same commit must produce byte-identical output

counting_policy.loc: physical lines, matching tools/loc/hawking_loc.py inclusion rules
counting_policy.exclusions: vendored/ and generated files are extracted but flagged vendored/generated=true and excluded from reduction candidate scoring
counting_policy.must_agree: sum of file-node loc for non-vendored non-generated files must equal the hawking_loc.py combined_active_monorepo_LOC within 0.5%
